Version 1 was in force on the loss date, with ₹2,500 deductible and zero-depreciation not in force; zero-depreciation was added by END-5512 effective 2026-10-13.

Latest registered supporting files are a 2-page FIR, invoice IMG_4417.pdf version 2, and 1-page survey report; the prior invoice version is superseded. The available tools classified documents but did not expose their contents.
No other claim matched the claimant key or vehicle registration in the available claims data, and no quality-event record matched CLM-88421. No fraud score was available.

assessment.summary: Fast-track settlement at ₹4,07,500: the ₹4,10,000 assessed collision amount less the ₹2,500 policy deductible. The policy was in force on the loss date, and the claim is below the ₹5,00,000 fast-track threshold. The only concrete timing flag is that zero-depreciation was endorsed after the loss; it must not be applied. No linked claim, quality-event match, or fraud score was found. Document contents could not be read with the available tools, so this conclusion relies on the claim record, policy history, and document metadata/classification.
